title: ר' אחא אחוהי דמר אחאי

paragraphs: Rabbi Acha, brother of Mar Achai, beginning of Ellu Kesharim. Earlier Yuchasin wrote: “Rav Achui and Mar Acha, first chapter of Kiddushin; perhaps it means Mar Acha’s brother, whose name was Rav. Beginning of Ellu Kesharim: Rav Achadvoy asked.” End quotation. There is confused and mixed wording here. Our Kiddushin 22b reads Rav Achai of Acha; Maharshal writes Rav Achai bar Adda of Acha. Beginning of Ellu Kesharim 111b: Rabbi Acha, brother of Mar Achai. Maharshal, citing Tosafot Shantz: Rav Acha of Acha. The new editions give another reading, “of Acha,” a place name.
